learning_outcomes.text: Solves various integral problems using indefinite and definite integral calculation methods.
Performs applications of integrals in calculating area, volume, surface area, and arc length.
Analyzes the convergence of generalized integrals with appropriate criteria.
Examines the convergence of sequences and series and applies power and Taylor series to problems.

syllabus_topics: Indefinite integral, rules for indefinite integration, substitution method, integration by parts method.
Method of partial fractions, integration of trigonometric expressions.
Integration of irrational algebraic expressions, binomial integrals.
Definition and properties of definite integral.
